title: Cache crashed and stayed down
reason: The engineer blamed the upgrade for the crash, but the real cause was a rare segfault bug with no external trigger.
root_cause: The Redis cache container crashed with signal 11 after being upgraded to version 7.4, breaking connections to the cache and causing login and cart failures.
truth: Redis crashed once on a rare bug (signal 11, segmentation fault). The container has no restart policy, so it stayed down, and login and cart, which keep sessions in Redis, fail.
